meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打开流式细胞术数据文件,读取通道与事件数据,导出为表格
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做流式细胞术实验,需要直接读取 FCS 文件的元数据与事件数据
copy.tagline_en: Open flow cytometry data files, extract channel and event data, and export tables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run flow cytometry experiments and need direct access to FCS metadata and events

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 流式细胞术文件：读取版本、事件数、通道与元数据，把事件数据取成 NumPy 数组或导出 CSV，也能用数组新建、修改并写出 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要解析 FCS 文件、提取元数据或通道信息、把事件数据导出为 NumPy/CSV 等时触发；需要补偿、门控或 FlowJo 工作区时改用 FlowKit。

say.text: 读一下 sample.fcs，告诉我版本、事件数和各通道名称
say.note: 返回 FCS 版本、事件数与通道标签

say.text: 把 sample.fcs 的事件数据导出成 CSV
say.note: 以通道简名为列名写出 output.csv

say.text: 把这个数组写成 FCS 文件，通道叫 FSC-A、SSC-A
say.note: 生成 FCS 3.1 单精度文件

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can read and write FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 flow cytometry files: parse version, event count, channels and metadata, extract events as NumPy arrays or CSV, and create or modify FCS 3.1 files from arrays.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to parse FCS files, inspect metadata or channels, or export events to NumPy/CSV; for compensation, gating, or FlowJo workspaces use FlowKit.

say_en.text: Read sample.fcs and tell me its version, event count and channel names
say_en.note: Returns FCS version, event count, channel labels

say_en.text: Export the events in sample.fcs to CSV
say_en.note: Writes output.csv with channel labels as columns

say_en.text: Write this array as an FCS file with channels FSC-A, SSC-A
